source.title: Externalizing Research Synthesis and Validation in AI Scientists through a Research Harness

paper_evidence.strict_gating: Preparation uses explicit contracts and a worker-validator repair loop; downstream phases advance only after validator PASS.
paper_evidence.resumption: The master scheduler writes decision, phase status, blocking issues and evidence file paths into structured runtime artifacts that function as both audit trail and resumption checkpoints.
paper_evidence.non_acceptance: Convergence requires validator-backed pass status for all required phases and no unresolved blocking issues; partial or blocked is never accepted regardless of textual justification.
paper_evidence.iteration_limit: If convergence is not reached by the iteration limit, the best progress is returned with an explicit stop reason so incomplete evidence is not presented as validated.

code_evidence.prepare_status_contract: Managed prepare artifacts use only READY or BLOCKED.
code_evidence.blocked_path_validation: evidence_paths are checked as workspace-contained local paths and must exist.
code_evidence.worker_rule: READY requires acquired/verified local evidence and no remaining blockers; BLOCKED requires the blocker object and the same blockers in remaining_blockers. Search summaries are not completion evidence.
code_evidence.reviewer_rule: A BLOCKED result can PASS review only as a truthful terminal prepare blocker with documented searches/acquisition attempts, concrete rejected candidates, clear missing requirements and a specific required action; insufficient blocked evidence is FAIL.

protocol_implication.name: EVIDENCE_CARRYING_GENERIC_RESIDUAL_BOUNDARY
protocol_implication.rule: After all safely executable Chat-capable preparation is complete, a remaining protected/exclusive effect must be packaged as a non-success BLOCKED boundary with immutable evidence of completed predecessors, attempted routes and rejected alternatives, explicit missing capability/requirements, the exact external action required and exact return evidence. The clean sender must not execute the protected effect or claim final acceptance; independent/downstream verification must still decide irreducibility.
protocol_implication.distinction: A credible blocker may be locally validated as well-formed without becoming scientific completion or global acceptance.

scope_limits: Xcientist's concrete field is named user_action_required; the generic protocol generalizes the actor to protected authority holder, exclusive external authority holder or genuine user-input owner and does not treat manual execution as a substitute for an available Chat capability.
The public code demonstrates structural fail-closed blocker contracts and reviewer rules; it does not itself prove a protected-primary-writer authority model.
The generic protected-authority classification remains a protocol extrapolation constrained by the current sanitized role assignment, not a claim made by Xcientist.
